description: Regression corpus of representative 68K + AREXX doors. Each entry runs via web/backend/src/scripts/run-amiga-door.ts (or the AREXX-direct path), stdout is captured + diffed against goldens/<id>/output.txt. Adding a door: drop it into Doors/, register here, run with --capture to freeze the golden, then run without --capture to verify it stays green.

doors.name: WHO v2.0
doors.notes: WHO v2.0 by Spy/MST. Renders who's-online header banner then queries active nodes. Exercises XIM BB_MAINLINE / ACTIVE_NODES / MULTICOM ops + DT_SECSTATUS user-field path. Non-interactive, exits cleanly. Verified deterministic 2026-05-12.

doors.name: AquaWho
doors.notes: Aqua who's-online listing. Exercises XIM data-query path (DT_NAME/DT_LOCATION/DT_LINE_NO) for all nodes. Non-interactive — renders list and exits.

doors.name: 5D-TimeBank
doors.notes: 5D-TimeBank — time-deposit/withdraw door. 'Q' hotkey quits per its UI hint. Exercises XIM DT_TIMELIMIT + RAWARROW + JH_HK input path.

doors.name: LOGOFF v1.2

doors.name: 5D-ZippySearch II v0.11
doors.notes: 5D-ZippySearch by sTc/5D. Line-input prompt 'Enter string to search for >:'. Bare Enter aborts the search and exits the door. Exercises XIM JH_LI (line-input) path — first corpus door to cover that op.

doors.name: FAME TestDoor
doors.notes: FAME.library reference door (FA_DE103 SDK sample, TestDoor.c). Exercises FIM lifecycle MC_DoorStart -> NR_PromptChars (PutString+GetString) -> MC_ShutDown. Prompts 'Tell me something>:' then echoes "You've said: <input>". Manually verified end-to-end 2026-08-14 (task-9) with a local diagnostic fix for a pre-existing bug: AmigaDoorSession.ts's setLibraryOpenedCallback (line ~759) overwrites LibraryManager's callback (LibraryManager.ts:726) instead of composing with it, so fame.library's vector-install branch (LibraryManager.ts:797-801) never runs and OpenLibrary("FAME.library") returns a stub with an empty jump table -- the door then crashes with an invalid-PC fault the first time it calls into FAME.library, before FIMStart completes. Confirmed by temporarily adding the missing fame.library branch to AmigaDoorSession.ts's callback (reverted, not committed -- out of task-9's file scope). Not yet green via corpus-integration-runner pending that fix landing.

doors.name: FAMEWHO v1.2
doors.notes: FAMEWHO v1.2 who's-online door for FAME BBS (FAMEWH12 SDK sample). Exercises FIM lifecycle plus who's-online formatting via FAMEAllocObject/RawDoFmt. fame.library vector-install bug fixed (ExecLibrary.ts now composes library-opened callbacks instead of overwriting -- LibraryManager's fame.library branch runs again); NR_GetArgument1-4/NR_GetFullArg (FIM commands 87-91) and MC_ShutDownLastWords ansi-output emission are now implemented (fim-protocol.ts). Verified 2026-08-14 (task-9 fix round): door runs crash-free end to end, EXIT 0, no TRAP/PANIC/Guru/Software failure. It now reaches FAMEWHO.c's FindSemaphore("FAMESemaphore") check (line ~285) and gets NULL, because nothing in amiexpress-web publishes a FAME-style public SignalSemaphore with a fsem_FirstNode multi-node info list -- that is real AmigaOS FindSemaphore behavior for a semaphore genuinely not present, not a wiring bug. Per FAMEWHO.c's own logic (line ~421: else { Permit(); } falling through to FIMEnd(0)), the door then does a silent, argument-independent MC_ShutDown with no lastWords -- by design, not a fault. Net effect: no visible output, but no crash either. Producing real who's-online output would require a new feature (FAME.library publishing/populating a FAMESemaphore from amiexpress-web's own multi-node session state) that is out of scope for this fix round.
